The season began on 17 July 2017 and was scheduled to end in May 2018. Ten teams competed throughout the entire season. ==Teams== [[Chorrillo F.C.|Chorrillo]] formed with Deportivo Centenario de Coclé and la Universidad Latina de Panamá to become Unión Deportivo Universitario therefore there was no need for a relegation.
